_comment: HOLDOUT set: written by the project owner before any retrieval changes. Never used for tuning; `python -m app.eval --holdout` reports it at the start (baseline) and the end only.

_format.query: the question text, as a user would type it
_format.kind: one of: direct | paraphrase | error_code | inflection | short | negative
_format.expected_article: KB-01..KB-07 for a positive query; null for a negative (should be insufficient evidence)
_format.allowed_articles: negatives only: article IDs that MAY be retrieved without counting as a false positive, e.g. ["KB-06"] when that article explicitly disclaims the topic; otherwise []
